class.name: VFXGraphAsset
class.brief_description: Data-driven particle effect description consumed by [VFXGraphInstance3D].
class.description: A [VFXGraphAsset] stores a Niagara-style effect as plain data: a [Dictionary] of emitters, each with spawn modules, update modules, custom attributes and event routing. The same format is understood by the GDScript reference runtime, so existing graph dictionaries can be wrapped without changes. [codeblock] { "emitters": { "sparks": { "max_particles": 64, "duration": 0.0, "attributes": {"heat": 0.5}, "spawn": [ {"type": "spawn_burst", "count": 64}, {"type": "lifetime_random", "min": 0.6, "max": 1.3}, {"type": "initial_velocity", "direction": Vector3.UP, "spread": 70.0, "speed_min": 4.0, "speed_max": 11.0}, ], "update": [ {"type": "gravity", "gravity": Vector3(0, -14, 0)}, {"type": "collide_plane", "normal": Vector3.UP, "restitution": 0.35, "on_event": {"emitter": "embers", "count": 1}}, ], "events": {"death": {"emitter": "embers", "count": 2, "inherit_velocity": 0.5}}, }, "embers": {"max_particles": 128, "spawn": [{"type": "lifetime_random", "min": 0.4, "max": 0.9}], "update": []}, } } [/codeblock] [b]Spawn modules:[/b] [code]spawn_rate[/code] (rate), [code]spawn_burst[/code] (time, count), [code]initial_position_sphere[/code] (radius, center, surface), [code]initial_position_box[/code] (size, center), [code]initial_position_cone[/code] (axis, angle, height, center), [code]initial_velocity[/code] (direction, spread, speed or speed_min/speed_max, radial), [code]lifetime_random[/code] (min, max), [code]initial_color[/code] (color, color_b), [code]initial_size[/code] (min, max), [code]initial_attribute[/code] (attribute, min, max). [b]Update modules:[/b] [code]gravity[/code] (gravity), [code]drag[/code] (drag), [code]curl_noise[/code] (strength, frequency, scroll), [code]vortex[/code] (center, axis, strength, pull), [code]attractor[/code] (position, strength, radius), [code]color_over_life[/code] (stops of [code][offset, Color][/code], or a [Gradient] under [code]gradient[/code]), [code]size_over_life[/code] (stops of [code][offset, float][/code]), [code]collide_plane[/code] (normal, offset, restitution, friction, on_event) and [code]kill_below_plane[/code] (normal, offset). The two plane modules run after position integration. [b]Emitter keys:[/b] [code]max_particles[/code], [code]duration[/code] (0 means unlimited emission), [code]attributes[/code], [code]spawn[/code], [code]update[/code], [code]events[/code] ([code]death[/code] and [code]collision[/code] specs), [code]blend[/code] ([code]"alpha"[/code] or [code]"add"[/code]), [code]texture[/code] ([Texture2D]) and [code]bounds[/code] (half extent of the culling box used by the renderer). An event spec is [code]{"emitter": name, "count": n, "inherit_velocity": 0..1}[/code] or an array of them. A bare emitter dictionary (without [code]"emitters"[/code]) is accepted and treated as an emitter named [code]"main"[/code]. Use [method validate] to get readable errors before playing a graph.

method.name: create_from_dictionary
method.description: Creates an asset holding a copy of [param graph].

method.name: get_emitter
method.description: Returns the definition of the emitter [param name], or an empty dictionary if it does not exist.

method.name: get_emitter_names
method.description: Returns the emitter names in definition order.

method.name: get_module_names
method.description: Returns the names of every supported spawn and update module.

method.name: get_system
method.description: Returns the normalized system dictionary ([code]{"emitters": {...}}[/code]); a bare emitter dictionary is wrapped as emitter [code]"main"[/code].

method.name: get_total_max_particles
method.description: Returns the sum of [code]max_particles[/code] over all emitters. This is the cost reported to [VFXBudgetServer].

method.name: has_emitter
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if an emitter called [param name] exists.

method.name: has_particles
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the total particle capacity is greater than zero.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [method validate] reports no errors.

method.name: validate
method.description: Checks the graph and returns one human-readable message per problem: unknown module types, modules in the wrong stage, parameters with the wrong type, unsorted or malformed stops, undeclared attributes and event specs that reference unknown emitters. An empty array means the graph is valid.

method.name: validate_graph
method.description: Same as [method validate] for an arbitrary graph dictionary.

members.member: The graph dictionary. Assigning it stores a deep copy of the containers; resources such as [Gradient] or [Texture2D] are shared.
